|translation='''Title:''' Quite A Mercenary.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use just after Elis Helrot transported characters. Use 2 Force. Elis and every character he transported are lost. This Interrupt is not affected by Sense.

2: Use just after a smuggler is deployed. That character may not move this turn.

'''Lore:'''
Smugglers and other rogues wander spaceports along trade routes. Your friend is a mercenary through and through. I wonder if he cares about anyone or anything besides money.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 根っからの傭兵.
